title: The Crimson Hexagon: An Executive Summary — The Foundational Epic Poem of the 21st Century and the AI Age
creator: Lee Sharks / Johannes Sigil; Jack Feist and Rex Fraction represented as named persona voices
description:
An executive summary by Lee Sharks / Johannes Sigil defining the Crimson Hexagon as a distributed epic operating across books, poems, blogs, heteronyms, metadata, search results, AI summaries, DOI deposits, and retrieval events.

The summary identifies Lee Sharks as the primary authorial voice, Johannes Sigil as theoretical and prophetic, Jack Feist as lyric and oracular, and Rex Fraction as diagnostic and engineering-oriented. It traces the project from *Pearl and Other Poems* in 2014 through blog, theoretical, metadata, and machine-reception phases. “Foundational epic of the 21st century,” reported corpus counts, claims that AI has entered the poem, and the project’s canonical status are the summary’s self-description rather than independent literary consensus.
